questions.question_text:
$\begin{array}{c|c|c}\text{10 less}&\text{Number}&\text{10 more}\\\hline A&195&B\\C&D&195\end{array}$
Where does the number $175$ go?

options.why: Subtracts only one ten from 195, giving 185 rather than 175.
Confuses the 10-more entry with a value below the central number.
Stops at the middle value 185 instead of subtracting the second ten.

questions.solution_text: Since 195 is 10 more than $D$, $D=185$. The entry 10 less than D is $185-10=175$, so 175 goes at C.
